summary: community.general 13.1.0 deprecations: unused cloud, database, known_hosts and saslprep module utils, the dconf fallback without gi.repository, layman, pushbullet and spotinst_aws_elastigroup.
questions: Is pushbullet being removed from community.general?

answer_card.title: community.general deprecations (13.1.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `cloud`, `database`, `known_hosts`, `saslprep` module utils: unused, removed in 13.0.0 (copy them if you use them).
- `dconf`: fallback when `gi.repository` is unavailable removed in 15.0.0.
- `layman`: Gentoo deprecated it; removed in 14.0.0.
- `pushbullet`: depends on a Python 3.2-only package; removed in 13.0.0.
- `spotinst_aws_elastigroup`: depends on a Python 2.7-only package; removed in 13.0.0.
